name: datacommons-mcp
description: Access the Data Commons Knowledge Graph with automatic large dataset handling, CSV export, and data lineage tracking.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Get statistical observations from Data Commons. Supports automatic CSV export for large datasets (>500 rows) with data lineage headers.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Search for statistical indicators, topics, and variables in the Data Commons Knowledge Graph.

api_key.title: DataCommons API Key
api_key.description: API key for accessing Data Commons. Get yours at https://apikeys.datacommons.org/

storage_dir.title: Storage Directory
storage_dir.description: Directory for storing exported CSV files. Defaults to ~/Documents/datacommons-data if not specified.

screen_row_threshold.title: Screen Row Threshold
screen_row_threshold.description: Maximum rows to return directly. Larger responses are automatically exported to CSV. Default: 500
